extras.title: Giving the critic the real checklist does not help
extras.one_sentence_finding: In the unified SI protocol, a critic that receives the benchmark (golden) evaluation checklist and marks each item in one call does no better than free-form feedback; the failure is lenient judgment, not missing checklist content.

extras.title: Image and geometry metrics are weak judges
extras.one_sentence_finding: CLIP-style scores separate passed from failed checklist items only weakly, and reference-based 3D/2D metrics rank edits close to chance; geometry metrics are blind to non-geometric edits such as recoloring.

extras.title: Three high-effort votes are not ground truth
